package_source_review.review_method: Visual comparison of all 80 numbered positions with Figure 11. This records a manual source review; automated checks detect changes to the reviewed transcription.
package_source_review.scope: Primary package signal and displayed alternate functions. PA address/data multiplexing and active-low typography are abbreviated in the viewer. This does not identify the physical MCU fitted to the supplied ECU.

code_to_pin_review.scope: Manual cross-check of code operands, input/output setup and datasheet register-to-package mapping for all 35 firmware-linked entries. Conditional on the MC9S12T64 reference model and register block based at zero. Missing boot prevents verification of all inherited mode/multiplex settings. Not a hardware continuity or full functional coverage certificate.

yamaha_temperature_candidate.status: inferred conditional profile; ECU identity and analog circuit unconfirmed
yamaha_temperature_candidate.basis: Both digital curves admit a constant ratiometric NTC pullup across XT660 resistance specifications. TDM900 fail-safe values match both fallback codes under this formula.
yamaha_temperature_candidate.conflict: XT660 2004 manual specifies coolant fail-safe 80 C; this formula gives 60 C. TDM900 specifies 60 C. This does not identify this dump as TDM900 firmware or prove its board matches either manual.
requires: NTC to ground with constant pullup to ADC reference
sensor specifications apply to this ECU

nominal_xt_timer.status: service-correlated nominal; not measured on this ECU
nominal_xt_timer.basis: TSCR2=5 gives bus/32. Fan diagnostic repeats every 250 tasks; each task is 4*2500 timer ticks. Yamaha specifies a 5-second fan cycle with 2 seconds on, 3 off.

nominal_xt_crank.status: conditional: 11 capture intervals including one double interval interpreted as one crank revolution
nominal_xt_crank.basis: Counter wraps at 11; gap interval is halved; A44 sums six normalized pitches; A36 contains three. Rotor-to-crank and TDC phase require independent confirmation.

software_reports.scope: Independent Python evaluator of exported raw p-code; confirms C translation consistency, not silicon equivalence.
software_reports.audit_action: Report/source provenance checked; fixtures not re-executed by ledger build

software_reports.scope: Synthetic software fixtures; no connector continuity, voltage measurement, transceiver test or complete ECU boot. Counter values are routine invocations or preseeded timer states, not independently measured milliseconds. Wire assignments require separate manual/board evidence.
software_reports.audit_action: Report/source provenance checked; fixtures not re-executed by ledger build

software_reports.scope: Independent formulas/decision tables versus instruction translation. No peripheral timing, physical units or connector identity certified.
software_reports.audit_action: Report/source provenance checked; fixtures not re-executed by ledger build

software_reports.scope: Synthetic CPS input, manually emulated ECT output and ISR stopped after spark dispatch. Normal gates, selected periods, fixed final spark/dwell inputs. Does not establish rotor-to-TDC angle, board polarity, actual hardware tooth count or every special mode.
software_reports.audit_action: Report/source provenance checked; fixtures not re-executed by ledger build

software_reports.scope: Isolated execution of the compiled instruction translation; no peripheral model or vehicle validation. Synthetic fixtures modify only temporary process memory.
software_reports.audit_action: Report/source provenance checked; fixtures not re-executed by ledger build

software_reports.scope: Isolated instruction translation, RAM-backed peripherals, and injected lookup results. Tests prove arithmetic at stated boundaries, not every caller path, physical clock/sensor units or hardware operation.
software_reports.audit_action: Report/source provenance checked; fixtures not re-executed by ledger build

software_reports.scope: Instruction-level fixtures, not a complete boot or hardware simulation. Tests establish code paths and boundaries, not gear-number calibration, neutral circuit polarity, wall-clock periods or mechanical TDC. The successful sequence uses changed calibration bytes only in emulated memory; it is not stock behavior.

evidence_scope.hypothesis_note: 20 pulses was selected for a numerical fit, not independently sourced. The synthetic gear traces do not establish sensor pulse count or actual gear numbering.

software_reports.audit_action: Report/source provenance checked; fixtures not re-executed by ledger build

software_reports.scope: Does not execute tracking eligibility/history acquisition, all alternate upstream filters, downstream lookups, analog circuitry or pressure calibration. Passing does not establish kPa.
software_reports.audit_action: Report/source provenance checked; fixtures not re-executed by ledger build

software_reports.scope: Isolated routines with injected ADC results and fault states. No proof about every possible upstream state writer, external analog circuit, donor ECU identity or physical units.
software_reports.audit_action: Report/source provenance checked; fixtures not re-executed by ledger build

software_reports.scope: Planner arithmetic includes synthetic edge cases. Timeline is a uniform wheel segment with normal gates clear and manually simulated ECT pin state. Special-mode dispatch, physical coil polarity, timer frequency and TDC phase are not established by this test.
software_reports.audit_action: Report/source provenance checked; fixtures not re-executed by ledger build

software_reports.scope: Isolated instruction execution with RAM-backed peripherals. Physical units, oscillator rate, sensor circuitry, crank/TDC geometry and hardware outputs are not validated by these tests.
software_reports.audit_action: Report/source provenance checked; fixtures not re-executed by ledger build
